body:
Enhance Your AdvancedEnchantments Experience with Clear Chinese Descriptions!
AdvancedEnchantments Chinese Description Addon is a simple yet essential client-side mod designed specifically for servers and players utilizing the AdvancedEnchantments plugin. This mod does one job and does it well: it adds native Chinese descriptions to all the custom enchantments, ensuring every player can understand the effects of their gear.

Features:
Complete Chinese Support: Native, clear Chinese translations for enchantment descriptions.

Intuitive: No configuration required—install, and it works!

Client-Side: Purely client-side, no server-side installation needed (unless your server forces translations).

Vanilla Feel: Integrated seamlessly into the default Minecraft enchantment lore style.

Compatibility: Works on Fabric and Forge (please check the file lists).

Requirements:
Minecraft Version: 1.8.9

Mod Loader: Forge

(Optional but Recommended) AdvancedEnchantments Plugin (Client is usually fine without, but descriptions won't show).
